Four Naga civilians killed by militants near Myanmar border in Manipur

Four Naga civilians were found dead near the Indo-Myanmar border in Manipur's Kamjong district. The victims, identified as Tangkhul Naga men, were discovered with multiple bullet wounds. Local reports allege that Myanmar-based extremists, possibly Kuki groups-backed forces, carried out a cross-border attack near Pilong village on Thursday night. The bodies have since been laid to rest.
